Metadata.title: Manar Trading — Fresh Red Sea & Gulf Seafood in Saudi Arabia
Metadata.description: Manar Trading supplies fresh Red Sea and Arabian Gulf fish to homes, restaurants and hotels across Saudi Arabia. Landed daily, iced within minutes, delivered same day.
Metadata.ogTitle: Manar Trading — Fresh Seafood, Saudi Arabia
Metadata.ogDescription: Red Sea and Arabian Gulf fish, landed daily and delivered same day across the Kingdom.

Hero.subtitle: With Manar Trading, you get fresh seafood to start your day right, fuel your business, and bring your family together at the table — every single day.

fish.title: Reef, coastal & pelagic fish
fish.copy: Hamour, Najil, Shaari, Safi, Kanad and Yellowfin — landed on the Red Sea and Gulf coasts and priced by the kilo every morning at 06:30.

shellfish.title: Prawns & shellfish
shellfish.copy: Gulf tiger prawns, head-on and still snapping, bought each morning of the licensed season and sold only on the day they land.

orders.title: Standing kitchen orders
orders.copy: A fixed list, the same delivery window every morning, and one contact who knows your kitchen. Restaurants, hotels and caterers across the Kingdom.

Footer.newsletterTitle: What came off the boats, in your inbox at 6:30
Footer.companyTagline: A family seafood house supplying homes, restaurants and hotels across Saudi Arabia with Red Sea and Arabian Gulf fish since 2009.
